query:
INSERT INTO loads.stop (
                id, load_id, kind, date, name, line1, line2, city, region, postal_code, country
            )
            VALUES (
                $1,
                $2,
                $3,
                to_date($4, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
                $5,
                $6,
                $7,
                $8,
                $9,
                $10,
                $11
            )
